searchText: Do we have an equivalent for goerli https://testnet.forkmon.ethdevops.io/ ? If someone sends me some RPC addresses (yeah I know it's last minute) I run a goerli client, do I have to do anything? I've already upgraded my geth to the latest version that works with London No, updating to the newest version was the only thing that node operators need to do ok, thanks Just sent to you you should make sure to double your gas limit near the fork block
